periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented obliquely, converging downward toward the muzzle at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated oval geometry, with the vertical height approximately 1.4 times greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a distinct downward tapering, with the lowest point of the patch shifted significantly inferior to its geometric center, creating a teardrop effect.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band across the upper torso occupies approximately 30 percent of the visible vertical torso length between the neck and the hind limbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the inner margins of the pinnae is approximately 1.2 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, highly convex circular curvature with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: The abdominal pelage displays a significant reduction in density and a distinct brownish-tan discoloration compared to the bright white fur of the head and chest.
